chunks: Follow what has been revealed to you by your Lord, and do not follow any other lord apart from Him. Yet little do you care to remember.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command regarding following revelation versus other authorities?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf underscores the principle of *Tawhid* by commanding adherence to the Quran while rejecting *Awliya'* (guardians or intercessors) other than Allah, often interpreted as the Ahl al-Bayt or divine guides who do not possess independent authority. It serves as a reminder that true reflection (*Tadhakkur*) leads to recognizing the singular source of guidance, distinguishing between those who merely claim authority and those divinely appointed. This directive reinforces the Shia emphasis on following the Prophet's message without adding human intermediaries who might distort the pure monotheistic creed.
